comment: The Graph panel's Oklab cloud at UI scale 2, at the panel's default size, over three painted strokes. The strokes are painted at scale 1 and the scale is raised after, because a stroke painted at scale 2 ends a little differently from run to run and a record must repeat. The cloud's cell follows the picture, two texels a cell, so at scale 2 a cell is one logical pixel and the points read as many small marks, and the state names the cells, the plot's side and the picture's size in real pixels.
